summary.title: INFRALOGIQ AS

narrative.text: INFRALOGIQ AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Detaljhandel med jernvarer, byggevarer, fargevarer og glass", registered 2011-02-21.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 42,726 and an annual result of NOK 21,607.
Registered leadership: Ingunn Olimstad Bjerkelo (Daglig leder); Ingunn Olimstad Bjerkelo (Styrets leder).
Head office in Sandnes, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
